chunks: En": "Regarding two men who testified against a man whose wife was absent that he had divorced her, so the woman observed the waiting period and married another; then the absent husband returned and claimed he had not divorced her, and one of the two witnesses proved him false. He (peace be upon him) said: 'The other [witness] has no claim upon her, and the dowry is taken from the one who testified and returned, and it is returned to the latter [husband], and they are separated, and she observes the waiting period from the latter, and the first [husband] does not approach her until her waiting period is completed.'"}

key_terms.اعْتَدَّتِ: Ella observó el periodo de espera (Iddah)

ai.seo_question: ¿Cuál es la norma fiqh cuando un esposo ausente regresa y se demuestra que uno de los dos testigos de divorcio es falso?
ai.summary: Esta norma del Imam al-Sadiq (AS) ilustra el principio de 'kadhīb al-shāhid' (el testigo mentiroso) en el contexto de los maridos ausentes, donde la carga de la prueba recae sobre los testigos. Establece que el testigo falso soporta la penalización financiera devolviendo la dote al segundo esposo, mientras que el primer esposo debe observar la 'iddah del segundo matrimonio antes de reunirse, asegurando la validez de la unión intermedia.
